risk_note: F1-15a (orchestrator D10-1225, planning/05 F1-15 doable part). Admin config center: the six growth.invite_reward.* items (amount_fen, daily_budget_fen, total_budget_fen, min_paid_fen, ip_window_hours, eligibility_days) get Chinese names, descriptions and scopes, sit in the invite-code rules group (checked before the risk-threshold group), money items show and edit in yuan via the existing parseYuan / @couli/money path (integer fen sent), hours / days items accept positive integers only; budget 0 is not shown as unlimited. Kill switches: growth.invite_reward.enabled gets a name and an impact line per 08 BR-INV-24 (turning it off stops new eligibility, existing eligibility still pays; stopping payouts is payout_paused). ValueField now wraps validation errors in a role=alert element (antd ErrorList has none), for every config item. Reward records list and budget usage are out of scope until the backend implements adminListInviteRewards. Rule tests by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh); Codex spec-test r1 pass; red on couli-ci (15 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5: couli-ci fast run 4 green (15 rule tests and every frozen admin test), run.ts static 10/10; the couli-ci browser runs were killed by test-machine OOM (admin-unions page crash), admin-config-center / admin-kill-switches browser tests passed there and on the host. Codex general review r1 pass, no findings. Written by hand.
